note: Synthetic sentences only. Not study data and not an end-to-end benchmark. Labels were adjudicated for this regression: a conversational hedge is meta-discourse about the utterance; a genuine condition constrains the situation; an ambiguous condition could be read either way and is preserved. A preserved condition is provisional and does not authorize tier 3. Readings stay deterministic_provisional. Two-stem endpoints are what this package counts as grounded. The short training/confidence sentences are the reported reproductions. They still decide authorizes_tier_3. They do not by themselves meet the two-stem grounding rule.

labels.conversational_hedge: Unambiguous meta-discourse. It does not govern the from-to link. The remaining clause can authorize tier 3.
labels.genuine_condition: The if-clause constrains the situation. Status is hypothetical. authorizes_tier_3 is false. The row stays below tier 3.
labels.ambiguous_condition: The if-clause may be a hedge or a real condition, including a substantive verb such as help or understand. It is preserved. Status is hypothetical. A provisional reading does not authorize tier 3.
